overloads.semanticRole: Combines two pictures (pict1, pict2) using the given combination mode (horizontal/vertical concatenation or superimposition) into a third, compound-type resulting picture.

constraints: operator selects one of three combination modes (constants of the 'Picture Transformation' theme): 1 = horizontal concatenation, 2 = vertical concatenation, 3 = superimposition.
horOffset/vertOffset only apply when operator is superimposition (3); they translate pict2 before superimposing it onto pict1.
Differs from the & and | picture operators: those always rasterize to a plain bitmap, while COMBINE PICTURES preserves the compound-type characteristics of the source pictures.
